"Superstitious" is a 1988 single released by the Swedish rock band Europe.
It was the first single released from the album Out of This World.
It performed moderately well, peaking at #31 on the US Billboard Hot 100, #9 on the Mainstream Rock Tracks and #34 on the UK Singles Chart.
Out of This World is the fourth studio album by the Swedish rock band Europe.

Released on 9 August 1988 through Epic Records, the album was a commercial success selling over 3 million units worldwide, peaking at number 19 on the US Billboard 200 chart and reaching high positions in charts worldwide.
It was recorded at Olympic Studios and Townhouse Studios, London, England.
